description: FFmpegKit / ffmpeg-kit, actively maintained. Drop-in replacement for com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-video (Arthenica's fork, retired April 2025) -- same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, just change the groupId. Video codecs: dav1d, fontconfig, freetype, fribidi, kvazaar, libass, libiconv, libtheora, libvpx, libwebp, snappy, zimg. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
